leadText:
Mossgreen Village (Japanese: マツモタウン Matsumo Town) is an -exclusive location in Kanto. It is a small town found between the and Cinnabar Island. It was featured in The Problem with Paras.

Mossgreen Village is home to a medicine shop, which is owned by Cassandra and her grandmother . They make their own potions to sell to traveling s, which is how they ended up meeting and . The shop has its very own , which helps them make the medicines and potions they need. There is also a that helps guard the shop.
